answer: Stake bonds priced per identity stop the hollow blowup. Each agent pairs one software key with a sealed TPM chip, so a single cipher can never be cloned across ten thousand virtual shells. On every task, twenty percent of an 800-token bond enters escrow, and a peer-disputed lie burns that slice within a day, so repeated cheating exhausts the reserve after five strikes. A botnet minting 10,000 fakes must lock 8 million tokens in bonds and survive months of honest traffic to reach the zenith of trust, a cost that makes mass forgery pointless, like renting an army you immediately disarm.
